saturation.note: Chapters reached zero new reusable moves across all chapters at pass 3 for data-analysis and pass 2 for every other chapter; the pass counts per chapter are carried in g2 chapter_passes records.

g3_mining.method: Three-level harvest per section 8.5. Surface scan for repeated strings and ordinal openings; syntactic scan for recurring frames; semantic scan for shared information order under different wording. Occurrence reconciliation attached every confirmed occurrence and rejected word-sharing units that perform different jobs, which is why the 101 units reduce to 97 distinct pattern ids rather than merging into clusters: the maximum pairwise Jaccard overlap of the information-order-plus-elements signature across all pairs is 0.209, so no two units are the same routine twice.
repetition_levels_searched: shared information order under different vocabulary
false_matches_rejected: P-F-Q435-031 (From-the-chart, it is evident that plus a value) against P-F-Q435-062 (From the figure plus a variable that correlates with several others): both open with a figure reference but one reports a value and the other promises a set, so the payload differs and the two stay apart.

P-F-Q435-033 (It provides valuable data support for, after a figure) against P-F-Q435-096 (The final results provide valuable data support for, at a processing section end): same predicate under a different subject and a different chapter position, kept apart as a variant pair.

P-F-Q435-066 (human preprocessing justification naming the harm prevented) against P-F-Q435-095 (machine-faced justification naming the downstream activities): the justification target differs, so the order differs.
connector_only_rejections: Additionally appears at LU-048, LU-067, LU-071 and LU-079 but carries four different jobs and is therefore not itself a pattern.
However appears at LU-010, LU-024, LU-050 and LU-064 with four different jobs.
In contrast appears at LU-006, LU-050, LU-053 and LU-064 with four different jobs.

original_instantiations: Pushing the question one step further, the schemes were sorted against the four domains set out by the national regulator (NR) in the Water Services Index (WSI): Treatment, Network, Demand, and Governance. Splitting on each domain's score gave two camps, and each camp's mean cost of service was taken as the comparison statistic. Within a camp the schemes were cut again - for instance, high and low scorers on Treatment alone - so that like could be set against like. Framing it this way lets the analysis trace how much each domain contributes and where a scheme is strong or weak.

A second pass took the analysis deeper by sorting the routes against the three dimensions given by the transport agency (TA) in the Road Safety Index (RSI): Geometry, Enforcement, and Surfacing. Grouping on each dimension's score produced a high and a low set, with the mean crash rate of each set used for comparison. Each set was then split once more - high and low scorers on Geometry, for example - to keep the comparison fair. Sorting this way exposes how much each dimension carries and pinpoints where a route is deficient.

units.source_excerpt: Our team sincerely hopes that your country will build a secure, stable, and prosperous cyberspace to safeguard the public's efficient and convenient online lives, thus promoting the stable development of the economy and society, and ensuring long-term national stability.
units.function: Close the letter with a wish that chains three benefits, each caused by the one before it.
units.rhetorical_move: Our team sincerely hopes that returns to the first person plural and is the letter's only expression of hope beyond the offer clause at the start. The wish is addressed to your country and names its object as three coordinated adjectives, secure, stable, prosperous. Then a to-safeguard purpose clause names the public benefit as two more adjectives, and then a thus-promoting clause and an and-ensuring clause extend the chain outward, from the public to the economy and society to the nation. Each link moves up a level of generality, and the last is the most abstract thing in the paper.

chapter_label_note: The paper numbers its chapters 1 to 9 with its own names. The protocol-v2 schema fixes a canonical chapter vocabulary, so each printed chapter is translated to the canonical label whose rhetorical job it performs, and the paper's own name is kept in paper_chapter and in section. Two sections that do not behave like their parent chapter are re-labelled: the model chapter's pattern analysis and theoretical summary are results work, and the data chapter's analysis and visualization sections are results work, so those units carry chapter results. This is a translation for the schema and not a claim about the paper.
